description: HTML source code for a web-based database visualizer interface, including styles and client-side scripts to load and display database information dynamically.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database to show tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for data table display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates individual cell HTML, handling lengthy content and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses content within a table cell.
